correctness.rationale: The proof derives the stable-colour histogram from complete rooted universal-cover types (Krebs–Verbitsky, arXiv:1407.3175, Lemma 2.6); its new spine lemma identifies every unicyclic cover as a uniquely decorated bi-infinite path. Primitive period and global dihedral equivalence determine cover types, and aggregate repetition determines their multiplicities. The minimum simple-cycle length yields the exact generating factor. Both distinct standalone programs reproduce the ten coefficients through n=9, one additionally matching the complete seven-vertex graph atlas. All-order correctness rests on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: This is a complete and nontrivial invariant for a natural hereditary graph class under a standard counting logic. The all-order quotient reduces many disconnected graph structures to primitive period totals and yields an exact coefficient generating series, including the first sharp failure of isomorphism identification at n=6. The 1- and 2-letter period constraints are forced by simple-graph topology, and the result is not merely an arbitrary cutoff or software enumeration.
